query:
DEFINE
    VAR _entity = TREATAS ( {{ "P" }}, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _fy     = TREATAS ( { 2026 }, param_fiscal_year[fiscal_year] )
    VAR _month  = TREATAS ( { 9 }, param_period[month_number] )
    VAR _tv     = TREATAS ( { "YTD" }, param_time_view[time_view_code] )
    VAR _base   = TREATAS ( { "A" }, param_base_version[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_a  = TREATAS ( { "B" }, param_compare_a[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_b  = TREATAS ( { "PY" }, param_compare_b[choice_code] )
    VAR _ccy    = TREATAS ( { "USD" }, param_reporting_currency[currency_code] )
    VAR _fx     = TREATAS ( { "ACT" }, param_fx_basis[fx_basis_code] )
    VAR _units  = TREATAS ( { "M" }, param_units[units_code] )
    VAR _kpis   = TREATAS ( { "NR", "ORG_GROWTH", "GM_PCT", "GTN_PCT", "AP_PCT", "CM_PCT", "EBITDA", "OP" }, dim_kpi[kpi_code] )
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    dim_kpi[kpi_code]
    ,dim_month[month_index]
    ,dim_month[month_key]
    ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units, _kpis
    ,"@v", CONVERT ( [KPI Trend], DOUBLE )
)
ORDER BY dim_kpi[kpi_code], dim_month[month_index]
